test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Siliguri __has joined the nation to celebrate__ the golden jubilee of the first conquest of Mount Everest by an Indian.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "Siliguri has joined the nation to celebrate the golden jubilee of the first conquest of Mount Everest by an Indian" is grammatically correct and conveys the intended meaning effectively.
 
• The phrase "has joined the nation" is appropriate in the context, meaning that Siliguri is participating with the nation in the celebration.
 
• Therefore, there is no need for any improvement or substitution in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Siliguri has joined the nation to celebrate the golden jubilee of the first conquest of Mount Everest by an Indian."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "joins the celebratory nation"** – This is an incorrect structure and changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• **2: "joining the nation celebrate"** – This construction is awkward and doesn't fit grammatically.
 
• **4: "joined the national celebration"** – This is grammatically incorrect and changes the meaning from participation with the nation to the idea of "celebration" itself, which is not intended in this case.
 
• **No improvement required** – The original sentence is correct as is and doesn't need any changes.
